title: Crystal melt stored at Hex Star (Dheneb, lawless) sold into its bid where it lies
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-24 15:33 UTC (MISSION: surplus liquidated; rules F24, F23). Hex Star bid 3,508 cr x 142 for crystal melt (table books, read 15:27:50 UTC); a trader stores 20 melt there (holdings 15:30 UTC). sell-loot-at-dheneb sells melt too but is gated on stored ember glands, so it stays closed while none lie there: one route per flowing good (trade-books pitfall). The pilot whose own storage at Hex Star holds 5 melt or more withdraws what the bid takes at its best price and sells at 3,000 or more; the rest stays stored.
